newsitem.title: USA: ASI says over-allotment option exercised.
newsitem.headline: ASI says over-allotment option exercised.

text.p: ASI Solutions Inc said Tuesday that H.C. Wainwright & Co Inc, the managing underwriter of its initial public offering, has exercised its over-allotment option.

The offering of 1.8 million shares of ASI common stock closed on April 21, 1997. Under the over-allotment option, the underwriters will purchase an additional 270,000 shares of common stock from certain stockholders.

The shares purchased by the underwriters are to be used for the purpose of covering over-allotments related to the sale of shares in the initial public offering. ASI said it will not receive any of the proceeds.
ASI provides a range of human resources outsourcing services.
